reason: One immutable utility specification keeps argv forms, observable stream/status/effect contracts, source evidence and fixture references together. These are catalog data, not runtime dependencies or grants; splitting into parameter bundles would hide one command contract. Retain at the measured17 fields with no growth; strict generation, scoped option/owner closure and detached snapshot tests support the decision. P03 moves the unchanged pure fact shape into toolcontract so guidance and execution consume one declaration without importing the parser.
